h_conclusions.H1_documented_default_form: Standalone form (no -user) executed 3 times in distinct variants (file-path -gen, directory -gen, +-qcerr, plus a guard-free depot run: 4 related attempts): always exit 1 in 2.5-2.8 s, zero stdout/stderr, zero windows, zero artifacts, zero writes. Attempt 14 additionally ran the corrected form with -use_value default (with directories and -user): it reached the automatic generation stage and failed deterministically at '#IP Generate Failed!' (same as copy mode). Conclusion: no headless generation succeeded; the standalone default form remains undiagnosed (it cannot surface dialogs without -app_path) but the failure mode observed elsewhere is systemic at the generation stage.
h_conclusions.H2_copy_form: The interactive reality is proven: without -use_value the tool ignores -no_status and opens the configuration window waiting for a human (attempt 13: 900 s, window captured; earlier H2: 600 s). With -use_value (copy or default) plus the corrected directory form and -app_path, the tool runs its AUTOMATIC path: it exports the instance scaffolding (8 files, 57,702 B), sets PH1P_REF_CLK=100.00 / PH1P_DDR_SPEED=800.00 and deterministically reports '#IP Generate Failed!' in ~2.5 s (byte-identical tool log across attempts 11/12/14). The corrected form is therefore validated as far as the tool's own automatic stage; the residual failure is systemic (independent of copy vs default) and its detail lives in a short-lived td_commands_prompt.exe child whose output is not persisted (no td_*.log anywhere; likely launched with -nolog). Earlier diagnosis stands: -user and -gen are validated as directories (error dialogs captured in attempts 9/10).
h_conclusions.H3_tcl_entry: Confirmed working as a scripting/diagnostic entry (positive control passes), but it exposes no generation command: no generate_ipinst in any context; create_dialog is only in the static help table and is NOT a registered command; library commands exist but generation is out of their scope. The only GUI-adjacent command semantics remain create_dialog ('create the IP setting dialog then generate'), unavailable in script mode.
h_conclusions.H4_xmlipgen: Exists in project context but is an internal engine step requiring an undocumented prepared XML set ('XmlIpGen cannot find all xml file'), no usable help, invalid-option errors for guessed parameters. Not a usable standalone headless entry in this experiment.
h_conclusions.H5_gui_boundary: The private-copy launcher opens the real configuration window (capture preserved). No binding marker within 40 s; no generation without human interaction. GUI dependency confirmed for the interactive route; the marker behavior needs a human-in-the-loop validation run.

limits: No complete DDR IP product exists (any speed/config); the success branch was not triggered and no parameter/pin acceptance checks could be executed. The scaffolding under output/ is partial and is NOT a candidate.

The residual '#IP Generate Failed!' cause at ~2.5 s was not identifiable within the budget: values load (verified), the ADC file exists locally (verified), yet the failure persists; its detail lives in a <0.5 s td_commands_prompt.exe child whose output is not obtainable with routine tooling (no td_*.log, no inherited stdio).

The precise edit in our prepared instance that breaks copy-value loading was not isolated; the tool-era unedited instance loads values correctly (mechanism verified), so a consistent-value preparation strategy can be built later (e.g. generate once via GUI, or replicate the tool's own file-set transitions).
The '#IP Generate Failed!' path is identical for copy and default modes and across four tool-era-instance runs with byte-identical tool logs - deterministic, hence reproducible.
IpTool rewrites D:/downlaod/bin/.setup.ini (window position cache) on every automatic run - detected and reported in each attempt.
No hardware actions; no bitstream; no writes to D:/downlaod other than the tool's own .setup.ini; no writes to frozen projects.
